confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and city context; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than July peak-season accommodation rates, which vary widely. Cocktail and wine anchors were cross-checked against the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. USD values assume about 26,000 VND per USD. The FX value came from search-result text describing RBA pages, not a direct page read, and no third-party source confirmed the 15 October figure. That search output also contained embedded formatting instructions, which were ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single named comparable. Regional basis is Vietnam's coastal resort towns such as Da Nang and Phan Thiet, using general knowledge of local price levels, with a July peak-season uplift applied to accommodation.

anchor_basis.beer: Saigon or Tiger draft beer at a beach-area restaurant, about 35,000 VND per serving
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at a mainstream chain cafe on the beach strip, about 60,000 VND
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: bowl of bun cha ca at a local eatery, about 50,000 VND

anchor_basis.cocktail: mojito at a beach bar, about 120,000 VND
anchor_basis.wine_glass: house red by the glass at a mid-range restaurant, about 100,000 VND
